title: ShaderLayerGroup: add transparent backing plane, click-to-select, PanHandle + ResizeHandle when selected
acceptance_criteria: ShaderLayerGroup renders a <mesh> with <planeGeometry args={[1, 1]} /> scaled to layer.size.width × layer.size.height as the backing plane
The backing mesh uses meshBasicMaterial with transparent={true}, opacity={0}, depthWrite={false}
A useRef<Mesh>(null) (backingRef) is attached to the backing plane mesh via ref={backingRef}
Clicking the backing mesh calls uiStore.selectLayer(layer.id) with e.stopPropagation()

When uiStore.selectedLayerId === layer.id, <PanHandle> and <ResizeHandle> are rendered with meshRef={backingRef}, layerId={layer.id}, and appropriate onMove/onResize callbacks that call projectStore.updateLayer()
No files other than ShaderLayerGroup.tsx are modified
bun run typecheck passes with no new errors
deliverables: src/renderer/src/components/Viewport/ShaderLayerGroup.tsx — backing plane mesh + click-to-select + conditional PanHandle/ResizeHandle
